get.summary: Get the CSV template for bulk disbursement funding adjustments.
get.description:
Returns a downloadable CSV template file for the bulk disbursement funding adjustment endpoint,
containing a sample row with the expected columns: MerchantId, TransactionId, OriginalAmount, AdjustmentAmount.

post.summary: Process bulk disbursement funding adjustments from a CSV file.
post.description:
Processes bulk disbursement funding adjustments from a CSV file uploaded as multipart form data.
The CSV must contain columns: MerchantId, TransactionId, OriginalAmount, AdjustmentAmount (header row is optional).
Only one file is allowed per request. Each row is validated for sanity (positive amounts, adjustment <= original)
and for duplicates. If all rows pass sanity checks, the engine validates each transaction (exists, correct type,
matching merchant, not fully reversed, remaining balance sufficient) before processing.
Returns a {RepayGatewayApi.Engine.Engines.BulkTransactionProcessingResult} on full success, or a CSV file with per-row results
(including error messages) on partial or full failure.

post.summary: Process a single disbursement funding adjustment.
post.description:
Processes a single disbursement funding adjustment for a card transaction. The adjustment amount must be
positive, cannot exceed the original amount, and the original transaction must be a DisbursementFunding type.
The engine validates the transaction exists, matches the merchant, has not been fully reversed, and the
adjustment amount does not exceed the remaining balance.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the original disbursement funding transaction to adjust.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The adjustment request containing merchant ID, original amount, and adjustment amount.

post.description:
Processes a full reversal of a disbursement funding transaction. Validates that the original transaction
is a DisbursementFunding type and has not already been fully reversed.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the disbursement funding transaction to reverse.
